subject.title: Bug: isRecurringTopOfHourCronExpr fails to match cron expressions with step values

question: Which path should own the cron minute-zero stagger fix while https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/1175 remains open and is not maintainer-editable?
rationale: The bug remains in current main, but a live closing PR already owns the implementation path; automation should not create a duplicate fix until maintainers decide whether to review, adopt, replace, or close that PR.

options.title: Review linked PR first
options.body: Evaluate the open fork PR as the active candidate and either land it if acceptable or ask for changes from the author.

options.title: Replace with maintainer-editable fix
options.body: Close or supersede the uneditable fork PR and allow a narrow replacement branch that preserves credit and follows the same source/test boundary.

options.title: Defer semantics decision
options.body: Keep the issue open without implementation until maintainers decide which sub-hour minute expressions should receive the default stagger.

recommendation.title: Review linked PR first
recommendation.body: Evaluate the open fork PR as the active candidate and either land it if acceptable or ask for changes from the author.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the default cron stagger controls and is the strongest current history signal for the affected behavior.
